subject: Request: Executive presence for system blueprint walkthrough

Cc: Ben Sullivan <ben.sullivan@olivetech.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec attendance for Aug tech walkthrough?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the time last week — the product demo was helpful. Our engineering leadership (Ben, copied) would like a short technical deep-dive on the Redwood serving architecture and the migration plan we're considering.

To make the session productive for our execs, could you confirm whether a senior exec (CEO or CPO) from Redwood could join the first 20 minutes for context and commitments? We want senior-level alignment before we get into low-level design.

Target window from our side: Tue Aug 1 or Thu Aug 3, 30–45 minutes US Pacific hours (10:00–14:00 PDT). If those don't work, we can look at other dates the week of Aug 7.

No slides required from the exec beyond a 5–10 minute intro; Ben and I will lead the technical portion.

Appreciate a quick note on availability and who would attend from Redwood.

Best,
Emma
Product & Partnerships
ClearWave.ai

- Our plan: Aisha Rahman (CEO) can join the first 10–15 minutes for framing and commitment; Rishi Malhotra (CTO) will stay for the full session to lead the architecture discussion.

Emma / Ben, if none of those slots work, let me know the week of Aug 7 and I will escalate.
